run_benchmark_data_loading: run the benchmark_data_loading function to measure data loading speed over multiple epochs
benchmark_dataloader_performance: benchmark the PySlowFast dataloader performance by timing iterations and tracking RAM usage per epoch
measure_epoch_timing: measure average and standard deviation of epoch timing across multiple benchmark runs
profile_ram_usage: profile CPU memory usage during data loading iterations and log RAM consumption per epoch
shuffle_and_benchmark: shuffle the dataset per epoch and benchmark data loading speed with configurable log periods
